definitions.acceptance_rate: Accepted noncached strings / newly scored strings; not accepted/ACTs and not a certified-literal-caption success rate.
definitions.accepted: Rank+relevance accepted; includes semantic repeats, NOT novelty increments.
definitions.comparisons: Budgets, start times, sampling, and source histories differ; no matched H2 or causal comparison.
definitions.dedup: Exact replay/cache excluded from new scoring, acceptance and pixels. Native and scorer views are joined, never summed.
definitions.format_fault: Stored parser fault; can coexist with scored/accepted strings. Routing ambiguity is separately counted and can overlap it.
definitions.literal_quality: Raw scorer strings can be descriptions/commentary; see separate hash-bound82-span content audit. No claim that all parsed/scored strings are humorous captions.
definitions.new_pixel: Accepted candidate assigned a new per-scene embedding cluster; provisional operational novelty, not proof of a distinct joke idea.
definitions.no_caption: Retrospective parser diagnostic, not a judge rejection.
definitions.planned_unknown_attempts: Optional declared cardinality absent (event.planned is None), not unknown scoring or a format fault; null means not collected for this player.
definitions.windows: Absolute partial/full UTC windows. Counts are not extrapolated per-hour rates. Empty windows omitted; absence is not uptime proof.

players.attempts_unit: Unique ACT origins reaching scorer across deduplicated historical/current sessions; not all native cycles.
Completed controller ACT attempts with recorded outcomes; multiple repairs can belong to one opportunity.
